FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 204
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Shay Shelnutt
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/02/2025
Senate Bill 204 as introduced would allow covered beneficiaries to roll-over unspent annual
benefit maximum dollars into the succeeding year for payment or reimbursement of dental care
service. However, this bill limits the amount to be accumulated to two times the annual benefit
maximum that is in effect for the preceding year depending upon the amount of unspent annual
benefit maximum dollars that could roll-over, and be used for payment or reimbursement of
dental care service claims. This bill could increase the obligations of; (1) the State Employee's
Insurance Board, by a board estimated $3.15m per year; and (2) the Public Education Health
Insurance Board, by a board estimated $9m per year.
Finally, this could increase insurance premium tax receipts into the State General Fund by an
undetermined amount dependent upon any increase in claims paid due to increased utilization of
benefits.
